name: A. H. M. Qamaruzzaman
role: Home Affairs Leader in the Provisional Government
contribution: He served in the provisional cabinet and helped oversee internal administration and political coordination during the war.
context: Mujibnagar government structure and wartime political leadership, 1971.
impact: He strengthened the political-operational backbone of the independence movement in exile.
highlight: A key organizer of wartime governance behind the front lines.
